title: Urology and Continence Supply Program: indwelling catheter exclusion
content:
On the Urology and Continence Supply Program, holding an indwelling catheter program excludes intermittent and external catheters. Holding either of those excludes an indwelling catheter program. A customer with an indwelling catheter in place does not also catheterize intermittently or wear an external catheter.

## Rule

- No product line is supplied to a customer who holds a program, in active or on-hold status, of a product line that the excluded pairs match with it. The excluded pairs are indwelling with intermittent, and indwelling with external. The test reads the customer's programs by product line and status.
- When the prescriber changes the customer from one line to the other, the earlier program is closed before the new program's first refill ships. A referral for the new line is accepted, but its program is not activated until then.
- Absorbent products combine with any catheter product line.

## Combinations

| Program held (active or on hold) | Intermittent | External | Indwelling | Absorbent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Intermittent catheter | not applicable | may be supplied | excluded | may be supplied |
| External catheter | may be supplied | not applicable | excluded | may be supplied |
| Indwelling catheter | excluded | excluded | not applicable | may be supplied |
| Absorbent products | may be supplied | may be supplied | may be supplied | not applicable |
